tool.name: Get.sabund
tool.description: Get sabund from a otu list or rabund
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$otu' otu.dat && ln -s '$count' count.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $label: #silent $mothur_args.append("label=" + str(str($label).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $count: #silent $mothur_args.append("count=count.dat") #end if #if $otu.is_of_type("mothur.list"): #silent $mothur_args.append("list=otu.dat") #elif $otu.is_of_type("mothur.rabund"): #silent $mothur_args.append("rabund=otu.dat") #end if
echo 'get.sabund(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.help: If your list file contains only the unique sequence names because you ran cluster with a count file, be sure to include the count file.

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The get.sabund_ command generates an sabund_ file from a list_ or rabund_ file.
.. _sabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/sabund_file/ .. _list: https://mothur.org/wiki/list_file/ .. _rabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/rabund_file/ .. _get.sabund: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.sabund/
